title: Increasing Number of Patients and Subsidy for Pre-implantation Genetic Screening
what_it_is: Increasing Number of Patients and Subsidy for Pre-implantation Genetic Screening

sections.label: PGS pilot eligibility criteria
sections.summary: MOH's PGS pilot aims to improve IVF live birth rates for women at higher risk of chromosomal abnormality embryos, with three eligibility criteria.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Under the Ministry of Health's (MOH's) pilot for Pre-implantation Genetic Screening (PGS), the intended objective is to improve in-vitro fertilisation (IVF) success rates leading to live births for specific groups of women who have an increased risk for embryos with chromosomal abnormalities.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Any woman who fulfills one of the following clinical criteria is eligible for PGS: (a) 35 years and above, regardless of prognosis; (b) suffered two or more recurrent implantation failures; or (c) experienced two or more pregnancy losses.

sections.label: MOH funding for PGS
sections.summary: MOH extended $1.7 million for the PGS laboratory and half of consumables costs, leaving patients to pay remaining consumables and biopsy costs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: MOH provides substantial funding for the PGS pilot programme.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: It has extended $1.7 million in funding to support the manpower and operations of the PGS laboratory, and half of the PGS consumables costs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: As a result, participating patients are charged only the remaining costs of the PGS consumables which average about $1,100 per test, as well as the cost of the embryo biopsy to remove cells for PGS testing which ranges from $2,500 to $4,500.

sections.label: PGS study recruitment numbers
sections.summary: 367 patients were recruited for the PGS study, exceeding the targeted 300 patients.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: A total of 367 patients were recruited for the PGS study, more than the targeted 300 patients.

sections.label: PGS attrition before biopsy
sections.summary: About 71.7% of enroled subjects dropped out before embryo biopsy and PGS testing; as of 30 September 2020, 367 were enroled but only 104 had biopsies.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: The high attrition rate of about 71.7% of enroled subjects before reaching the stage of embryo biopsy and PGS testing, indeed, remains a challenge.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: As of 30 September 2020, as mentioned earlier, 367 patients were enroled but only 104 had enrolled biopsies performed.

sections.label: Outcomes of euploid embryo transfers
sections.summary: Of 69 patients with euploid embryos, 60 had embryo transfers, leading to 31 pregnancies, 15 livebirths, eight miscarriages and eight on-going pregnancies.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: And of these 69 patients with euploid embryos, 60 underwent embryo transfers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: This led to 31 pregnancies with 15 livebirths, eight miscarriages and eight on-going pregnancies.
